title: Burrata Pastry Puffs
description: A simple and elegant pastry filled with creamy burrata cheese, perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Place a small spoonful of burrata cheese in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles and press edges to seal.
Brush tops with a little water and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh basil if desired.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
